usedFor: AutoQuote3D quotes and manages orders for 3D print shops; Dropbox stores the files. A “New Order” or “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D can save a file into a Dropbox folder with “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in AutoQuote3D, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each placed order gets its file saved to a chosen folder, ready for production. You can also decide whether existing files are added, replaced or updated.

watchOut: Both AutoQuote3D triggers poll, so files arrive a little after the order. “Upload File to Dropbox” takes the file from a public web link, so the order must supply one.
